persona: Plant accounts executive with growing costing work and a semi-qualified CMA
resumeText:
Pranav Kulkarni | Pune | pranav.kulkarni@example.com

EXPERIENCE
Senior Executive - Plant Finance, Deccan Forgings Pvt Ltd, Chakan, Pune (2021 - present)
- Prepare monthly product cost sheets for 120 forged components using BOM and actual consumption.
- Analyse material price variance and material usage variance against standard costs every month.
- Carry out month-end inventory valuation of raw material, WIP and finished goods.
- Run cost estimates and production order settlement in SAP CO for the plant.
- Prepare costing MIS with budget versus actual commentary for the plant head.

Accounts Executive, Deccan Forgings Pvt Ltd, Chakan, Pune (2019 - 2021)
- Booked vendor invoices and reconciled vendor ledgers for the plant.
- Gave stock schedules to statutory auditors during the year-end audit.

EDUCATION
CMA Intermediate, Institute of Cost Accountants of India, 2022
BCom, Savitribai Phule Pune University, 2019

SKILLS
SAP FICO, Excel, cost audit
